active_family: 271 autoregressive latent-sequence flow matching with conditional next-change decoding
current_bottleneck: The 270 family is now closed. The latent token state remains usable under teacher forcing, but the tiny per-step token-to-observation decoder is too weak. The next clean question is whether adding a compact current-history summary to the decoder fixes the short-horizon conditional law without reintroducing bypass-heavy architecture.
last_result_summary: Iteration 58 completed constrained ideation after closing 270c. 270c stayed at 1/11 and showed that level-vs-change target choice was not the decisive bottleneck; the decoder law itself is now the bottleneck.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 271a-v0: keep the autoregressive latent-sequence bottleneck and latent FM transition, but replace the tiny decoder with a conditional next-change decoder that sees both the transitioned latent state and one compact history summary from the same encoder.
current_best_model: Archived baselines retain the overall frontier at 4/11; the 270 restart family is still below that frontier but remains scientifically live.
current_best_note: Archived baselines still hold the 4/11 frontier. Within the strict first-principles restart line, 270 is now closed and 271 becomes the next clean test of whether a minimal conditional decoder is enough to keep the latent-token AR family alive.
